title: 第23章 此人必杀人心平第24章 瘸腿汉子守阁人
content_zh:
;;
这场风波来得快去得也快，但是留下的影响却久久未散。
等一众弟子散去之后，几乎是所有人都在第一时间开始熟背宗门门规。
回天雷峰的路上，李南廷轻声道：“为何你会觉得此人必杀？”
“我看不是有不少弟子都觉得那人的认错态度十分诚恳么？”
“再加上那老妪的情况，若是按照那弟子所说的去做，或许也并非不是一件好事。”
李观棋摇了摇头，他在没有开心眼之前就知道，这世间的很多人都是经不起人性的考验的。
当初他在小的时候就早已看遍了人性的丑态。
李观棋说出了自己对于这件事情的看法。
李观棋的声音十分平淡：“对于那名犯了错的弟子来说，他自己并没有觉得自己有错。”
“他觉得自己乃是仙门弟子，身份高贵。”
“看上那山下女子是那女子高攀了，况且他还留下了百两纹银。”
“这么多银子，对于山下之人来说足以后半辈子衣食无忧。”
“所以我说他自己并不会觉得有错。”
李南廷一下子就被少年的言语给勾起了兴趣。
于是轻声说道：“继续说。”
少年犹豫了一下继续说道：“对那山下的姑娘来说，心不甘情不愿，甚至觉得那大夏剑宗的弟子是个穷凶极恶的山匪无异。”
“明明大婚在即，却因此丢了清白，在她心里，那弟子就是恶。”
“而那姑娘的亲人老妪，面对一个害死了自己孙女的仇人，自然也不会接受那弟子给他当牛做马。”
“况且以那弟子的心性，若是今日放过他，难免会下山寻仇，杀人灭口！”

李南廷眼底闪过一抹精芒，沉声道：“不错！若是今日放走了他，那老妪恐怕也凶多吉少。”
“就算用灵咒植入那弟子心中，让他无法动手作恶，给那老妪当牛做马般使唤。”
“恐怕那老妪日日看到这仇人也不会有多高兴。”
李观棋继续说道：“所以我说此人必杀！”
“原因很简单，以儆效尤！”
“大夏剑宗的门规门风不可破，也是给所有人敲响了一个警钟。”
“特别是天金峰的峰主因此受到重罚，更是震慑了门下弟子。”
李南廷听完少年的话欣慰的笑了起来。
看来自己这个关门弟子不光是空有一份妖孽的天资。
其心性更是细如发丝，分析这件事情并非只从自己的主观判断。
更是考虑到了这一整件事中的所有人的角度和看法。
content_en:
;;
The storm came and went quickly, but the impact left behind is long-lasting.
After the disciples dispersed, almost everyone immediately began to memorize the sect's rules.
On the way back to Tianlei Peak, Li Nanting whispered: "Why do you think this person must be killed?"
"I don't think many disciples think that person's attitude in admitting his mistake is very sincere?"
"Coupled with the old woman's situation, if we do what the disciple said, it might not be a bad thing."
Li Guanqi shook his head. He knew before Kaixinyan that many people in this world could not stand the test of human nature.
When he was a child, he had already seen the ugliness of human nature.
Li Guanqi expressed his views on this matter.
Li Guanqi's voice was very calm: "For the disciple who made a mistake, he did not feel that he was wrong."
"He feels that he is a disciple of the Immortal Sect and has a noble status."
"The girl at the foot of the mountain is the one who has his eyes set on him. Besides, he also left behind a hundred taels of silver."
"This much money is enough for the people at the foot of the mountain to have enough food and clothing for the rest of their lives."
"So I said he doesn't feel he is wrong."
Li Nanting was immediately interested in the young man's words.
So he said softly: "Keep talking."
The young man hesitated for a moment and continued: "To the girl at the foot of the mountain, she is unwilling to do anything. She even thinks that the disciple of Daxia Sword Sect is a vicious mountain bandit."
"Obviously her wedding is about to happen, but she has lost her innocence because of it. In her heart, that disciple is evil."
"And that girl's relative, the old woman, faced with an enemy who killed her granddaughter, naturally would not accept that disciple being used as a horse for him."
"Besides, given that disciple's character, if we let him go today, he will inevitably go down the mountain to seek revenge and kill people to silence him!"
A flash of light flashed in Li Nanting's eyes, and he said in a deep voice: "That's right! If we let him go today, the old woman will probably be in trouble."
"Even if a spiritual spell is implanted into the disciple's heart, he will be unable to do evil and be used like a cow or a horse by the old woman."
"I'm afraid that old woman won't be very happy seeing this enemy every day."
Li Guanqi continued: "That's why I say this person must be killed!"
"The reason is simple, to serve as a warning to others!"
"The rules and traditions of Daxia Sword Sect are unbreakable, which is a wake-up call for everyone."
"In particular, the peak master of Tianjin Peak was severely punished for this, which shocked the disciples."
Li Nanting laughed happily after hearing what the young man said.
It seemed that he, a closed disciple, had more than just a demonic talent.
His character is as thin as a hair, and his analysis of this matter is not just based on his own subjective judgment.
It also takes into account the perspectives and opinions of everyone involved in this whole matter.
